baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal yawm and predicative takunu bind al-sama to the comparison ka-al-muhl.
baseline_models.mechanism: A severe event-time is constituted by a change of material regime: the elevated overhead cover is no longer a stable cover but presents as molten, oily, or residual matter.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day supplies an occasion whose defining occurrence is the transformation.
Being or occurrence in time makes the comparison a predicated state, not an unattached image.
The overhead sky or cover supplies the initially spanning upper surface.
Molten and residual substances supply viscosity, liquefaction, and loss of clean form.

changed_reading.before: A future day on which the sky merely resembles a named substance.
changed_reading.after: The event is marked by a material phase change of the upper cover into a viscous residual medium.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The subject al-sama carries branches of height and visible elevated outline, while al-muhl supplies formless molten matter.
baseline_models.mechanism: The comparison reverses the sky's defining geometry: what is high, visibly bounded, and overhead loses outline and cohesion. The disturbance is therefore not only color change but failure of the boundary by which height is perceived.

activation_trace.role: Rising height supplies the vertical distinction that the image destabilizes.
The looming raised outline supplies a visible boundary capable of losing definition.
Molten residue supplies the contrary condition: mobile matter without a stable outline.
Temporal predication makes loss of outline a realized condition of the sky.

changed_reading.before: The sky changes appearance while remaining the same kind of boundary.
changed_reading.after: The highest visible boundary itself loses the geometry that made it an elevated, coherent surface.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Yawm can be an open span, and the focus noun's root inventory holds both molten matter and deliberate non-haste.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two live branches of m-h-l let material viscosity acquire a temporal texture. Without replacing the molten sense, the image can make the event feel held, slow, and inescapably ripening toward a state change.

activation_trace.role: An open span of time allows the focus day to be experienced as duration rather than a point.
Deliberate calm and non-haste supply the slow temporal texture.
Viscous molten residue gives that slowness a material carrier.
Occurrence in time turns accumulated duration into an eventual realized state.

changed_reading.after: A suspended interval thickens toward transformation, so part of the terror is its slow and irreversible arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening's falling or settling event and the absence of anything that can push it away add direction and force to the focus image. The molten upper cover can now be read kinetically, as the beginning of an unopposable downward flow rather than a static resemblance.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies material positioned above and capable of descending.
Molten residue supplies the mobile substance of the inferred flow.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the downward onset and certainty of arrival.
Pushing away harm supplies the blocked counterforce: this event has no effective deflection.

structural_cues: 70:1-2 place an occurring punishment and the lack of a defender before the ascent and transformation sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies falling, molten matter, and failed deflection; I infer that the upper material moves downward and cannot be diverted. A live alternative is that ka-al-muhl describes appearance only and the opening establishes certainty without physical direction.

changed_reading.before: The sky has a static molten appearance.
changed_reading.after: The upper cover enters an undivertible molten descent as the promised event takes hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured duration, restraint, and the far-near reversal activate the temporal branch of m-h-l alongside its molten branch. The focus day becomes a threshold reached when a vast but measured interval, patiently held, is suddenly disclosed as near.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate non-haste supplies the held interval before release.
Molten residue turns temporal holding into a thickening material threshold.
Occurrence in time supplies the point at which the held condition becomes manifest.
An open span of time expands the scale of the focus day beyond ordinary daylight.
A quantity reaching its limit makes the long span finite and threshold-bearing.
Holding the self against rupture supplies active restraint during the interval.
Distance from nearness supplies the human estimate that the event remains remote.
Temporal nearness and an approaching end reverse that estimate and close the interval.

structural_cues: The measured span in 70:4, patience in 70:5, and antithetical far-near pair in 70:6-7 immediately precede 70:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies long measure, restraint, distance, nearness, and both delay and molten branches of m-h-l; I infer a held process crossing a temporal threshold. The live alternative is a simple contrast between divine and human estimates with no slow phase-transition mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an instantaneous cosmic anomaly on a date.
changed_reading.after: The verse marks release at the limit of a measured hold: immense duration and sudden nearness converge in the sky's phase change.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated predicate-and-comparison frame synchronizes two transformations. The upper cover liquefies while the hard raised mass softens into dyed wool, so the focus verse initiates a common loss of cohesion across the world's vertical structures.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies one major vertical structure.
Molten residue supplies loss of cohesion by liquefaction.
The repeated temporal predication places the mountain change in the same transformation regime.
A hard elevated aggregate supplies the contrasting solid structure.
Soft dyed wool supplies fibrous looseness and color after solidity fails.

structural_cues: 70:8-9 repeat takunu followed by a ka-comparison, coupling sky and mountains syntactically.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel grammar, molten residue, hard elevation, and soft wool; I infer a shared failure of structural cohesion. A live alternative is that the two similes are independent visual comparisons joined only as a list.

changed_reading.before: Only the sky undergoes an isolated change of appearance.
changed_reading.after: Sky and mountains enter complementary modes of de-cohesion, dismantling both the upper cover and the raised solid masses beneath it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Once the greatest cover becomes fluid, the following collapse of intimate and clan relations reads as the same containment failure at human scale. Near companion, spouse, brother, and sheltering clan remain visible but cannot hold, answer, or save one another.

activation_trace.role: The sky as overhead cover supplies the largest containing shelter.
Molten residue supplies the cover's loss of load-bearing and containing form.
Near kinship supplies the innermost social bond whose mutual asking fails.
Companionship and close attendance supply another ordinarily sustaining relation.
A person's clan supplies the wider kin container offered up but unable to rescue.
Joining a gathering refuge supplies the explicit sheltering function that now fails.

structural_cues: 70:10-14 expands from failed mutual asking through companion, brother, sheltering clan, and everyone on earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a liquefied cover and a sequence of bonds and refuge that cannot save; I infer a scale analogy in which social containment fails after cosmic containment. A live alternative is that the kin sequence only intensifies desperation and bears no mechanical relation to the sky.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse is cosmic scenery detached from the later family sequence.
changed_reading.after: The melting of the largest cover previews the failure of every nested human shelter, from intimate bond to clan to earth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exception for sustained practice activates a material counter-regime to the focus's uncontrolled liquefaction. Branch images of straightening by heat, calming a boil, standing evenly, and persistent guarding allow prayer to appear as repeated regulation that preserves form under thermal pressure.

activation_trace.role: Molten residual matter supplies the uncontrolled thermal and phase instability to be countered.
The failed upper cover supplies the large-scale example of form no longer being maintained.
Kindling and straightening by fire supplies controlled heat that can shape rather than dissolve.
Calming boiling and wetness supplies a damping action for unstable material.
Straightness, balance, and evenness supply the maintained form produced by regulation.
Persistence in guarding supplies the repeated maintenance required to keep that form.

structural_cues: The exception at 70:22 opens a sustained list, while prayer is marked by continuity at 70:23 and guarding at 70:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncontrolled molten matter and branches of heat-straightening, boil-calming, even standing, and maintenance; I infer a thermal-regulation analogy for sustained practice. The live alternative, and the primary lexical reading, is ordinary prayer and ethical constancy without a material analogy.

changed_reading.before: The cosmic liquefaction and the later practice list occupy unrelated domains.
changed_reading.after: The liquefied sky defines the instability against which sustained practice can be pictured, exploratorily, as controlled heat and continuous form-maintenance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late sequence moves from created form to effective capacity and explicit substitution. This generalizes the focus predicate: the sky's becoming is not a cosmetic anomaly but an instance of created forms having no absolute claim on their current configuration.

activation_trace.role: Being and occurrence in time supply the sky's contingent present configuration.
The familiar overhead cover supplies a seemingly permanent created form.
Molten residue supplies the radically substituted material condition.
Creative origination supplies the dependence of present form on an originating act.
Effective capacity to carry out an act supplies the power behind reconfiguration.
One thing taking another's place supplies explicit substitution as the governing operation.
Escaping or outstripping a pursuer supplies the negated possibility of blocking that operation.

structural_cues: 70:39-41 moves in order from creation, through capacity, to explicit replacement and inability to outstrip.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, capacity, substitution, and non-escape; I infer that the focus sky exemplifies the replaceability of created configurations. A live alternative is that 70:39-41 concerns replacement of people only and does not generalize to cosmic material form.

changed_reading.before: The sky's molten state is a one-off exception to an otherwise fixed order.
changed_reading.after: The sky's becoming displays a general contingency: even the most encompassing created form can be replaced by another material regime.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending converts the focus phase change into the hinge of a vertical choreography. The high cover loses form; bodies exit from below and move rapidly toward an upright marker; sight then lowers while disgrace becomes the new overpowering cover. Upper and lower, slow and fast, erection and abasement exchange their ordinary directions.

activation_trace.role: Height and elevation supply the upper pole whose stable form collapses.
The overhead cover supplies the enclosure that is replaced by another kind of covering at the end.
Deliberate non-haste supplies the slow pole later reversed by rapid emergence.
Molten residue supplies the deformation of the upper pole.
Passing outward from an enclosure supplies upward release from below.
The grave supplies the lower enclosure from which bodies emerge.
Speed as the opposite of slowness supplies the abrupt release of the previously held interval.
An erected prominent object supplies an upward-oriented target amid the collapse.
Lowering and submission turn the gaze downward after bodily emergence.
Overcovering and overpowering supply disgrace as the new inescapable cover.
The low and hanging condition completes the downward social and visual vector.

structural_cues: The closing sequence repeats yawm at 70:43, sends bodies from graves toward an upright target, and then lowers sight under disgrace; the branchless و ف ض at 70:43 is used only as an additional motion cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies high cover, molten deformation, grave-exit, speed, an upright target, lowered sight, and overcovering disgrace; I infer that 70:8 initiates a coordinated reversal of vertical and temporal vectors. A live alternative is a montage of separate judgment scenes without one governing choreography.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a self-contained picture of a changed sky.
changed_reading.after: The molten sky is the hinge of a full orientation reversal: the upper boundary gives way, the buried rise rapidly, and a new cover of abasement descends upon them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant w-s-m target for the focus root s-m-w. It remains focus-anchored through the supplied split mapping and the material comparison, but downstream prose should render it only as a graphic secondary overlay, never as the lexical gloss of al-sama.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sky's split inventory includes a visible identifying mark and a dye, while al-muhl supplies a mobile residual substance.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark makes the sky a sign-bearing surface.
A coloring dye supplies a mark that spreads through a medium rather than remaining fixed.
Molten oily residue supplies the spreading material into which the mark dissolves.

changed_reading.before: The sky is only the location of a catastrophic sign.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sign-bearing upper surface becomes its own staining medium: the mark is made by dissolution of what bore it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the melted-fat branch is form-distant from jamilan's ordinary beauty sense. It remains valid as a packet-backed material echo tied directly to the focus muhl and the preceding restraint, but downstream prose should call it a faint branch activation, not a translation or intended etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's molten residue is immediately preceded by a context branch that images melted fat within the instruction to patient restraint.

activation_trace.role: Molten residual substance supplies the focus image that receives the earlier material echo.
Restraint against rupture supplies the holding action before transformation.
Rendered or melted fat supplies an unexpected material pre-echo of the later muhl.

changed_reading.before: The patience instruction and molten-sky image have no material contact.
changed_reading.after: A faint branch echo lets patient holding carry a latent image of rendering, so restraint precedes and anticipates cosmic liquefaction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads temporal texture through distant branch images rather than translating al-muhl as delay. It remains anchored in the focus m-h-l branch and explicit context images of agitation, speed, and time pressure, but downstream prose should present it as a counterpoint between temporal regimes.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines an open event-span with m-h-l's deliberate non-haste, while later context supplies rapid agitation, speed, and compressed time.

activation_trace.role: An open span permits more than one experienced speed within the event.
Deliberate calm and non-haste supply the event's slow, impersonal pace.
Anxious quick agitation supplies the contrasting human tempo.
Speed as the opposite of slowness supplies the terminal acceleration.
Time pressure, haste, and delay supply the felt compression at the encounter's end.

changed_reading.before: The event and its human participants move within one uniform apocalyptic instant.
changed_reading.after: The event advances with viscous inevitability while humans oscillate between agitation, sudden acceleration, and compressed time.

strongest_changes: The measured span, patience, and far-near reversal recast the focus as release at the limit of a long temporal hold.
The paired mountain simile expands sky-liquefaction into a coordinated loss of cohesion across vertical structures.
The closing grave-exit, upright target, lowered gaze, and overcovering disgrace turn 70:8 into the hinge of a vertical and temporal reversal.
The failed kin and refuge sequence lets the melted upper cover preview failure of nested human shelters.
summary.what_was_special: Material and spatial branch images did the most work: cover became residue, hard elevation became soft fiber, restraint became delayed release, and the final motions replaced the lost sky-cover with an overcovering abasement. Split mappings also preserved mark-dye and heat-regulation readings as contained explorations rather than lexical claims.
remaining_uncertainties: The downward motion of the molten sky is inferred from the opening occurrence and failed deflection; the focus comparison alone may indicate appearance without flow.
The m-h-l delay branch and the non-dominant w-s-m mapping may be too distant for anything beyond explicitly exploratory prose.
The thermal-regulation reading of sustained prayer may be a productive cross-domain activation rather than a recoverable structural intention.
